title: Gauntlets of the Warmaster

sources.title: Heightened Manoeuvre
markers: | summary = '''Heightened Manoeuvre''' is a passive feature that gives enemies disadvantage against battle master manoeuvre saves.

summary: Gain +1 to attack rolls. Targets have disadvantage on saves against your actions that use the weapon action DC.

fields.Heightened Manoeuvre: Includes Battle Master manoeuvres, most weapon actions, both forms of Stunning Strike, and Water Whip. Effects that use a different DC, such as Arcane Shots and Dazzling Ray, are outside this bonus.
fields.Base value: 1600 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
